events.title: MTG Q1 Deep Dive: Market Reacts to Revenue Miss, Capital Return Remains Robust
events.body: Mortgage insurer MGIC Investment (NYSE:MTG) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q1 CY2026, with sales falling 3% year on year to $297.1 million. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.76 per share was 2.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
